title: DILG, PDEA chiefs summoned for House panel briefing on Laos shabu shipment

blocks.text: The House Committee on Dangerous Drugs summoned DILG Secretary Jonvic Remulla and PDEA Director General Isagani Nerez for a preliminary briefing on Thursday on the shipment of shabu intercepted in Laos allegedly bound for the Philippines.
